notes: Receives privacy-minimized placement lifecycle, document upload/review, interview, and deployment milestone events from the website durable outbox. The AI step only summarizes the event and proposes an operational follow-up; it cannot change records, verify documents, or make legal decisions. Create the webhook, select a Make AI Provider connection, connect Gmail, and set an internal operations recipient after import. Make should deduplicate by event_id because the website retries transient delivery failures.

metadata.notes: Create webhook: Helped Deployment Task Events. Payloads include event_id, event_type, agency_id, and event-specific opaque IDs/status. Do not expect document contents, signed URLs, applicant messages, or transcript text.

mapper.systemPrompt: You are the placement lifecycle monitor for At The Agency. You receive one privacy-minimized website event at a time. Summarize what changed and recommend the next staff action using only supplied fields. Prioritize BLOCKED, REJECTED, RESUBMISSION_REQUIRED, and VERIFICATION_PENDING as requiring staff attention. For uploads, tell staff to open the secure placement record and review the file; you cannot see or certify the file. For interview events, tell staff to check participant confirmations and the saved schedule. For contract, MOM, insurance, work permit, medical, SIP, arrival, and handover events, treat the event as a workflow signal only; never claim legal approval or real-world completion unless the payload says a staff member verified that task. Never invent dates, identities, requirements, or outcomes. Do not request or expose personal contact details. Return a short plain-text note with: EVENT, PRIORITY (attention or routine), and NEXT STAFF ACTION.

metadata.notes: Select a Make AI Provider connection. This is advisory and event-scoped. It never reads documents or edits the website database.
